Class InteractionChecks

  • Method Details

    • malformedGestureStateFailsDuringDecoding

      public static void malformedGestureStateFailsDuringDecoding(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      A gesture-state packet with an invalid mode ordinal fails during decoding. No in-game reproduction applies: this is a malformed-wire boundary that the normal client cannot send.

    • gestureStateTracksModeAndModifier

      public static void gestureStateTracksModeAndModifier(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, Function<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack,net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer> playerFactory)
      The server records the client's selected mode and current modifier state. To reproduce in-game: cycle to Bar mode, hold the modifier, and right-click an eligible item against a block. The server performs the Bar placement rather than another mode or an ordinary use.

    • interactionReadsOnlyTheMainHand

      public static void interactionReadsOnlyTheMainHand(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, Function<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack,net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer> playerFactory)
      Stack gestures act only from the main hand. To reproduce in-game: leave the main hand empty, hold a depositable item in the off hand, hold the modifier, and right-click a stack. The off-hand item is not deposited.

    • rotationValidatesHeldItemAndBlockType

      public static void rotationValidatesHeldItemAndBlockType(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, Function<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack,net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer> playerFactory)
      Redstone torches rotate Storage and Singles blocks, soul torches rotate Singles items, and Bar blocks do not rotate. To reproduce in-game: Shift-right-click each type with those torches and observe that only the matching gestures change orientation.

    • sneakingRotationsReachTheLoaderHook

      public static void sneakingRotationsReachTheLoaderHook(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, Function<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack,net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer> playerFactory, InteractionChecks.LoaderBlockClick loaderClick)
      Sneaking right-clicks reach the loader's real server interaction hook for both block and item rotation. To reproduce in-game: Shift-right-click Storage with a redstone torch and an occupied Singles cell with a soul torch. The block and item rotate respectively.

    • vanillaInteractionReachesDepositExtractAndPlacement

      public static void vanillaInteractionReachesDepositExtractAndPlacement(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, Function<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack,net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer> playerFactory)
      Vanilla block-use interactions reach deposit, extraction, and adjacent placement. To reproduce in-game: modifier-click an existing Storage pile with an item, plain-click it with an empty hand, then modifier-click the top of an ordinary block. The item deposits, extracts, and creates a new Storage stack in the three cases.

    • itemRotationTargetsOnlyAnOccupiedCell

      public static void itemRotationTargetsOnlyAnOccupiedCell(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, Function<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack,net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer> playerFactory)
      Item rotation affects only the occupied Singles cell on the view ray. To reproduce in-game: Shift-right-click an occupied cell with a soul torch, then an empty cell beside it. The first item rotates once and the empty-cell click changes nothing.

    • permanenceRequiresEmptyHandAndHonorsProtection

      public static void permanenceRequiresEmptyHandAndHonorsProtection(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, Function<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack,net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer> playerFactory)
      Permanence requires an empty main hand and obeys world protection. To reproduce in-game: select permanence mode and modifier-click Storage first with an item, then empty-handed, then inside a claim that denies the player. Only the unprotected empty-hand click toggles it.

    • extractionRefusesIncompatibleOrFullHands

      public static void extractionRefusesIncompatibleOrFullHands(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, Function<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack,net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer> playerFactory)
      Extraction refuses an incompatible held item or a compatible stack with no room. To reproduce in-game: plain-click stored stone while holding dirt, then while holding a full stack of matching stone. The Storage contents and held stacks remain unchanged.

    • fullTopFacePlacesTheSelectedStackType

      public static void fullTopFacePlacesTheSelectedStackType(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, Function<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack,net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer> playerFactory)
      To reproduce in-game: fill a Singles block, select Storage mode, hold an item, and modifier-click its top face. A Storage Stack appears above and receives the held items.

    • everyStackTypeBlocksPistons

      public static void everyStackTypeBlocksPistons(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      To reproduce in-game: extend a piston into each SomeStacks block type. Storage, Singles, and Bar blocks remain in place and the piston cannot push them.

    • rotationSoundThrottleSuppressesSameTickAndClears

      public static void rotationSoundThrottleSuppressesSameTickAndClears(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, Function<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack,net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer> playerFactory)
      Rotation sound pacing permits one sound per player within its throttle window and resets when player state clears. To reproduce in-game: perform rotation gestures faster than the throttle interval, disconnect and reconnect, then rotate immediately. Rapid repeats are suppressed; the reconnect clears the old player's pacing state so the first new rotation can sound.

    • playerMutationEmitsBlockChange

      public static void playerMutationEmitsBlockChange(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, Function<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack,net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer> playerFactory)
      A successful mutation inside a stack emits one block-change game event. To reproduce in-game: put a sculk sensor beside a Storage Stack and deposit an item; the sensor activates.

    • extractionEventsFollowBlockSurvival

      public static void extractionEventsFollowBlockSurvival(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, Function<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack,net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer> playerFactory)
      To reproduce in-game: extract one of two Singles or Bars beside a sculk sensor, then the last. The surviving block emits only change; removing the last item emits only destroy.

    • deniedCleanupEmitsOnlyBlockChange

      public static void deniedCleanupEmitsOnlyBlockChange(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, Function<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack,net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer> playerFactory, ProtectionChecks.RemovalObserver observer)
      To reproduce in-game: deny cleanup of a Singles or Bar block, then extract its final item. The empty block survives and emits one change vibration, with no destroy vibration.
